sanitizedPrompt: A luminous 16:9 landscape editorial artwork in a warm-ivory architectural space flooded with refined soft daylight. Viewed obliquely from above, one broad translucent cobalt-blue conversation ribbon sweeps across the frame in a single generous shallow curve, occupying seventy percent of the image. A few softly embossed message-bubble silhouettes fade into a clear empty central surface, expressing erased conversation content. One slender amber reference filament remains attached to the ribbon's rear edge and reaches a single small amber old-response fragment tucked closely behind it. The uninterrupted amber filament contrasts with the visibly emptied cobalt memory surface. Restrained violet edge highlights, physically convincing optical-glass translucency, elegant ivory reflections, soft shadows and a clear foreground-to-background depth. Sculptural computer-native semantics, a single unified visual group, calm imaginative editorial finish, all meaning conveyed through form and color.
